statement: US supply-chain risk designation tools were flagged by the industry group as being used as procurement leverage against specific AI vendors.
why: If security-designation tools become procurement levers, government AI compute buying could route around particular model vendors and their preferred hardware stacks.

impact.mechanism: Vendor exclusion from federal programmes redirects public-sector AI workloads and the associated accelerator purchases toward other suppliers.

evidence.excerpt: supply-chain risk designation tools, designed to address genuine national security threats, were being repurposed as procurement weapons against vendors the administration found inconvenient.

reasoning: The document reports an advocacy-group warning and a court finding of unlawful retaliation, but gives no contract values or volumes, so any effect on accelerator demand is inferred rather than measured.

confidence.basis: Inference from one secondary outlet with no quantified procurement data.
